name: haxefmod
description: Use FMOD Studio with Haxe on HTML5, HashLink, Windows, Linux, and macOS
releasenote: Added build-hdll command for compiling hdlls against custom FMOD SDK versions. HashLink builds now fail with an error on SDK version mismatch (would silently break before). Project-local .haxefmod/ directory used for tiered hdll fallback.
